# 12Gig Sdn. Bhd.

12Gig is a Sabah-founded digital service marketplace connecting independent
service providers ("Giggers") with individuals and organisations seeking
their services.

## People

- [Mohd Redzuan Hiew bin Mohd Daud](https://12gig.my/profile/redzuan-hiew): Co-Founder and Head of Technology of 12Gig Sdn. Bhd.
- [Syed Abdullah Mohamad](https://12gig.my/profile/syed-abdullah-mohamad): Founder and Business Development Lead of 12Gig Sdn. Bhd.
